title: Number of Burgers with No Waste of Ingredients
goal: Find nonnegative jumbo and small burger counts that use all ingredients.
strategy: Cheese fixes the total burger count. Two tomatoes per burger form the baseline; every additional pair converts one small burger into a jumbo.
